notes: Preliminary N-14 8C (dates of the proxy statement left blank as [ ], 2021). Two separate Agreements and Plans of Merger (GPM into GOF; GGM into GOF), each needing approval of its target's and GOF's shareholders and neither contingent on the other; recorded as one merger event with n_targets 2 (the count of target funds named, not a number the filing prints). Conditions: only the shareholder-approval condition is stated in the excerpt; the 'Terms of the Merger' section and the Exhibit B form of merger agreement (which would list the other closing conditions) fall after the excerpt cut, so other conditions (e.g. tax opinion, registration effectiveness) are not recorded. The filing says each Merger is 'intended to qualify as a reorganization' under Section 368(a) but does not state a tax opinion as a condition in the excerpt. No expected closing time, outside date, exchange ratio or collar stated in the excerpt. Meeting time is blank ('at [ ] (Central time)').
